decisions.question: What stack and destination?
decisions.answer: Astro, TypeScript, CSS; GitHub Pages /notth-web/; new website repository.

decisions.question: Who approves milestones?
decisions.answer: Owner approves requirements before design, design before production UI completion, UAT before acceptance; no auto-merge or auto-release.

decisions.question: Initial content language and documentation scope?
decisions.answer: English homepage; official docs remain in framework repo.
decisions.reason: Owner approved Gate 1 and merged baseline PR #1.

decisions.question: May visual design begin?
decisions.answer: Owner approved requirements v0.1 and merged PR #1. Gate 2/3 and release are not approved.
decisions.reason: Explicit owner message and observed merge.

decisions.question: May the design review proceed without Figma/Penpot?
decisions.answer: Owner temporarily deferred Figma/Penpot and authorized an Astro browser prototype for Gate 2. Editable external designs are deferred. Gate 2, Gate 3, merge and release still require approval.
decisions.reason: Owner: Tạm bỏ qua figma đc ko, then Oke triển đi after browser-preview proposal.

decisions.question: What should remain in the revised design?
decisions.answer: Owner requests headline typing animation, future setup-media placeholder and only the five workflow stage names below. Install becomes official docs link; reduced/no-JS headline is static final tagline. Gate 2 approval pending.
decisions.reason: Explicit owner feedback on the v0.1 preview.

decisions.question: May production hardening and QA proceed?
decisions.answer: Owner approved minimal v0.2 design by merging PR #2; observed main ca850a1d8c6f7ca4e7bd79b1dca58045ce89f7fc. Proceed to production/QA/UAT preparation, not owner acceptance or publication.
decisions.reason: Owner message plus confirmed GitHub merge.

decisions.question: Has the owner accepted the delivered scope?
decisions.answer: Owner explicitly approves Gate 3; PR #3 merge confirmed at main 7ea9812ea4e7d88baa7333d171568bcc830185a1. Manual test evidence remains unverified; no publication or assistant merge permission inferred.
decisions.reason: Owner message Tôi duyệt gate 3 rôig and observed PR merge.
